Shiny gallery

Source: vignettes/shiny-gallery.Rmd
shiny-gallery.Rmd

Open an app in a new tab to run R in your browser. The first launch downloads R and the required packages. The Shiny walkthrough explains the code behind the examples.

Old Faithful

Choose an eruption duration to see how long visitors waited for the next eruption.

Proxy playground

Compare cities, extend a passenger forecast, or rearrange an item chart using Shiny proxies.

Equalizer

Drag a frequency band and compare its live gain with the final value on release.

Linked charts

Hover or click a species in the dotplot to see its flowers in the same color.

Stock prices

Zoom from weekly SPY closes to daily prices for the selected dates.

Solar cycles

Switch the observatory from daylight to night to see the chart inherit the app’s theme.

Developed by Joshua Kunst.
